assumptions: The Stripe checkout session includes customer metadata with a plan name or the plan can be inferred from the subscription item.

sources.title: Checkout Sessions have lower latency and new update semantics | Stripe Documentation
Using webhooks with subscriptions | Stripe Documentation
Add or remove member tags | Mailchimp Marketing API Reference | Mailchimp Developer
List members in segment | Mailchimp Marketing API Reference | Mailchimp Developer

notes: Stripe signs webhooks with a signature in the Stripe-Signature header; connector must verify using endpoint secret from Stripe Dashboard
The checkout.session.completed webhook fires after payment is successful and subscription is created.
Customer email is available at customer_details.email or via expanding the customer object.
Plan name should be retrieved from metadata.plan_name or inferred from subscription items if metadata is absent.
Webhook endpoint must be configured in Stripe Dashboard to receive this event.
Verify webhook signature using endpoint secret to prevent spoofing.
The list_id must be obtained from the Mailchimp audience/dashboard.
Email address is used as the unique identifier; if the member exists, it will be updated.
Tags array expects strings; duplicate tags are ignored.
Status_if_new controls subscription status for new members (subscribed, unsubscribed, cleaned, pending).
API key must be provided as Bearer token; format is apikey:<value> but library often handles encoding.
No pagination is involved in this single member add/update operation.
